events.artist: The Messthetics and James Brandon Lewis
events.subtitle: Fugazi's DC rhythm section meets free-jazz saxophone at Blue Note Tokyo
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents The Messthetics and James Brandon Lewis on January 21, 2027, with sets at 18:00 and 20:30. Fugazi alumni Brendan Canty and Joe Lally join guitarist Anthony Pirog and saxophonist James Brandon Lewis. The venue lists a ¥8,800 music charge, up to ¥14,300 for premium per-person reserved-seat packages, and separate January 22–23 appearances at COTTON CLUB, which are not included in this event record.

en.why_it_matters: The Fugazi rhythm section, Pirog's angular guitar and James Brandon Lewis's exploratory saxophone connect Washington post-hardcore to modern improvised jazz. The real draw is this four-way musical argument, now carried from DC to a Tokyo jazz room.
en.trip_verdict: Make room for the January 21 Blue Note set if already in Tokyo. This is a strong A+ crossing, not a one-time farewell or a reason to fly there exclusively.

es.why_it_matters: La base rítmica de Fugazi se cruza con la guitarra angulosa de Pirog y el saxofón de James Brandon Lewis. Ese diálogo entre el post-hardcore de Washington y el jazz improvisado gana una dimensión nueva cuando llega a Tokio.
es.trip_verdict: Si estás en Tokio el 21 de enero, le haría espacio a uno de los sets. Es un cruce A+; no una despedida ni una fecha que obligue a cambiar de viaje.

events.subtitle: Change the Wind — with Takuya Kuroda and Shun Ishiwaka
events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB announces Corey's Change the Wind sextet on December 21, 2026 with sets at 18:00 and 20:30. The official program names Takuya Kuroda, Itsumi Komano, Akira Ishiguro, Zak Croxall and Shun Ishiwaka. The presenter describes a project moving through jazz, soul, indie rock and cinematic arrangements, and lists table/seat categories ranging from ¥9,000 to ¥11,500 per person.

en.why_it_matters: Corey King's trombone, guitar and voice shift between soul and indie rock, while Takuya Kuroda's trumpet and Shun Ishiwaka's drumming keep pulling the band into jazz. Two trombones and this exact Tokyo lineup make the encounter worth prioritizing, beyond the album-tour label.
en.trip_verdict: Make room for one of December 21's sets during a Tokyo stay; strong A+ by lineup and musical interplay, not a special flight or a scarcity claim.

es.why_it_matters: Corey King pasa de la voz al trombón y la guitarra entre el soul y el rock independiente; la trompeta de Kuroda y la batería de Ishiwaka abren otra puerta hacia el jazz. Los dos trombones y este sexteto concreto justifican prestar atención, más allá de la presentación del disco.
es.trip_verdict: Si coincide una estancia en Tokio, apartaría espacio para un set del 21 de diciembre. A+ por la formación, no por una supuesta fecha irrepetible.

events.artist: Improv Nights 2027 — A Tribute to Derek Bailey
events.subtitle: Night 1 curated by gabby fluke-mogul
lineup: gabby fluke-mogul — violin and electronics, curator
Ka Baird — voice, flute and electronics
Lester St. Louis — cello and electronics
events.factual_description: Roulette's first night of its fifth annual Derek Bailey tribute takes place Thursday January 28, 2027 at 20:00. Curator gabby fluke-mogul's announced 11-person lineup performs in rotating smaller improvising combinations, with electric harp, live tap, electronics and acoustic instruments. General admission is listed at $25 advance / $30 at door; concessions are separate. Venue promises a free live stream.

en.why_it_matters: This Derek Bailey tribute earns admission for its actual first-night ensemble: Zeena Parkins' electric harp, Ka Baird's voice and flute, Nava Dunkelman's percussion, several electronically expanded strings, and even tap will collide in rotating ad-hoc groups. It is a live experiment, not a generic name on an anniversary bill.
en.trip_verdict: Actively prioritize January 28 on a late-January New York visit. Its fifth-annual, three-night format warrants A+ for the confirmed ensemble, not S or a dedicated trip.

es.why_it_matters: Esta primera noche del homenaje a Derek Bailey entra por sus músicos: el arpa eléctrica de Zeena Parkins, la voz y flauta de Ka Baird, la percusión de Nava Dunkelman, cuerdas procesadas y hasta tap. Las combinaciones nacen sobre el escenario; eso es lo excepcional del cartel.
es.trip_verdict: Si hay viaje a Nueva York a finales de enero, priorizaría el 28 en Roulette. La formación justifica A+, pero es la quinta edición de un ciclo y no hay evidencia para venderlo como irrepetible.
